name: OceanOps
tagline: Offline mission control for ocean alkalinity enhancement: plan, simulate and run deployments without unsafe pH spikes.
problem: Alkalinity deployments fail and harm marine life if a ship discharges too fast, and ships at sea cannot rely on cloud servers, the team says.
solution: Runs locally on edge hardware: ship-traffic and ocean data feed a fluid simulation and route planner, with a local language model and risk analysis in a globe-based mission control.
demo_moment: Team-described: plan a route, adjust discharge parameters and see the risk analysis.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Uses a real ocean-physics solver, not only an LLM.

lessons: Pair the local model with real domain physics to make an edge-AI story credible.
